title: Global Well-Posedness and Uniform Long-Time Control for a Class of Periodic NLS-Dysthe Equations
summary: We study a class of periodic NLS-Dysthe (NLS-Dy) equations, also referred to as higher-order nonlinear Schrödinger equations (HNLS), of the form $i\partial_t u+a\partial_x^2u+b|u|^2u+i\varepsilon(c\partial_x^3u+d|u|^2\partial_xu+eu^2\partial_x\overline{u})=0$ with $ x\in\mathbb T$, $a,b,c,d,e\in\mathbb R$, $abc\neq0$, and $\varepsilon>0$. For $0 3/2$ for arbitrary admissible coefficients, and establish an $H^1$ continuation criterion for $s\ge2$.
